title: Juicy Buttery Almond Crumble
description: A festive American dessert featuring flaked almonds caramelized in a buttery crumb topping for a sweet and indulgent treat.

ingredients.name: 3/4 cup unsalted butter, melted and cooled to room temperature

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix almond slices, sugar, and salt until well combined. Add melted butter and flour, stirring until the mixture is evenly moistened.
Transfer the almond mixture onto an 8x8 inch baking dish. If using, sprinkle chopped walnuts over the top for extra texture.
Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and crisp on the edges but still juicy in the center. Use a toothpick to check if it's done; it should come out clean without any sticky bits.
Allow crumble to cool slightly before serving, garnished with additional sugar crystals or fresh mint leaves for an extra touch of flavor.
